chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah ibn Sinan, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

A man from the Ansar came to my father (peace be upon him) and said: 'I am afflicted with a great matter. I have a slave girl whom I had slept with. One day I slept with her, then went out for a need of mine after having performed ghusl from her, and I forgot my expenses. So I returned to the house to take them, and I found my slave girl on her belly. I counted for her nine months from that day, and she gave birth to a girl.'

He (peace be upon him) said: 'So my father (peace be upon him) said to him: It is not befitting for you to approach her, nor to sell her, but spend upon her from your wealth as long as you are alive. Then bequeath at your death that she should be spent upon from your wealth until Allah makes a way out for her.'
ai.seo_question: What is the ruling for a master who impregnates his slave girl?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi elucidates the status of the *Umm al-Walad* (mother of the child) in Shia jurisprudence, establishing that her manumission is tied to her child's birth rather than immediate freedom. The Imam’s directive to maintain her financially without selling her underscores the principle of preserving her dignity and ensuring the child's lineage is clear, a key distinction from other schools of thought. This ruling highlights the practical application of Quranic principles regarding the rights of slave women who bear their master's children.

en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, form Ahmad Bin Muhammad, and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ibn Mahboub, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:

‘A man from the Helpers came over to my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup>, so he said, ‘I am afflicted with a grievous matter. There is a slave girl for me which I had slept with. So, one day I slept with her, and went out regarding a need of mine, after having washed from it, and I forgot my expenses. So returned to the house in order to take it, and I found my slave upon her belly. So I counted for her nine months from that day of mine, and the slave girl gave birth’.

He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘So my<sup>asws</sup> father<sup>asws</sup> said to me: ‘It is not befitting for you that you go near her, nor that you should sell her, but spend upon her from your wealth for as long as she is alive. Then bequeath at your death that he (your successor) should spend upon her from your wealth until Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Makes a way out for her’.
